text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from Period 1 to Period 10 despite several declines, so I should assess progress over a longer horizon rather than react to one month's change.","Doing nothing was a valid choice during these periods; I should trade only when a decision fits my plan, not just to feel active.","Before any trade, I should decide what evidence would change my view and apply the same standard to winners and losers, rather than cling to a purchase or sell out of fear."]}
